policy.training: issue13 full purged train only; validation never added; no retuning or early stopping
policy.exclusions: test-only whole groups: missing user, user/group/source in original train OR validation, or recorded_at before fixed test boundary; never change training
policy.quantiles: original P10/P50/P90; clip negatives to zero; never sort
policy.bootstrap: paired user bootstrap; seed 42; 1000 replicates; same draws across models/cohorts/weights
policy.selection: issue13 train-internal best baseline per cohort/weight; no test selection

bootstrap.method: paired user percentile bootstrap; all G users drawn G times with replacement
bootstrap.shared_draws: all five models, cohorts and weighting schemes
bootstrap.user_weighting: mean within user and cohort, then equal mean of participating users
bootstrap.empty_rule: omit draws with no cohort rows; report counts; unavailable CI is null
